description: The geo module with an invalid precision setting (SID_MODULE_CONFIG={"geo":{"precision":"city"}}): the module fails (status error) rather than guess, and the rest of the payload is returned. Requests describe the visitor's location with Cloudflare's visitor location headers (cf-ipcountry, cf-region-code, cf-ipcity, cf-postal-code, cf-metro-code, cf-iplatitude, cf-iplongitude, cf-timezone, cf-ipcontinent): the Node.js target reads them because it runs with SID_TRUST_PROXY, and the runner gives the Workers runtime the same values as request.cf. The time zones have no daylight saving time, so utcoffset is fixed.

cases.name: reports the module as an error and adds no location
